provenance_note: Official file from the TSE digital library's repository service, a static response. The researcher downloaded it twice on 23 September 2026 with identical bytes, and the independent check downloaded it again the same day with the same byte count and SHA-256. The kept copy was re-hashed for this packet with the same result. This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, PDFs, images and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
rights_note: Factual observations paraphrased with attribution; short quotations only. No photographs, seals, coats of arms, signatures, diploma images or long speech text copied. No open license, portrait permission or likeness approval is asserted.
scope_note: Catalogue record (REST JSON) of the TSE digital library item bdtse/539 (http://bibliotecadigital.tse.jus.br/handle/bdtse/539), a photograph of the 1989 diplomação ceremony; the record's lastModified is 2 April 2020. An archival description, not the minutes of the TSE session.

visual_review.method: JSON metadata read (dc.title, dc.date.issued, dc.description); the photograph itself was not reviewed.

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The TSE's catalogue describes the item as the ceremony of diplomação of those elected President and Vice-President of the Republic in the 1989 election, dated 1989-12-30, with Minister Neri da Silveira, Fernando Collor, Minister Francisco Rezek and Itamar Franco present.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-10 only. Election, diplomação, oath, posse, termo de posse, sash ceremony, authorization, summons, suspension, the Vice-President's exercise, resignation, vacancy, judgment, removal and disqualification stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Vice-presidents, ministers and party offices are excluded except the Vice-President's exercise of the office, recorded as rows only.
